```sql
WITH harris_region AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Harris' AND addr_state ILIKE 'Minnesota'
),
dem_clipped AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(
      r.rast,
      ST_Transform(harris_region.geometry::geometry, 4326),
      TRUE
    ) AS clipped_rast
  FROM
    public.dem_us r,
    harris_region
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(
      ST_Transform(r.rast::geometry, 4326),
      harris_region.geometry::geometry
    )
)
SELECT
  MAX(ST_Value(clipped_rast, 1)) - MIN(ST_Value(clipped_rast, 1)) AS vertical_range
FROM
  dem_clipped;
```
